describes: Canonical governance roles and the surface variants that map to them. Policy supplies the roles and their aliases (remappable per jurisdiction/domain, like vocabulary/risk.json and grades.json); the language owns only the mapping contract. Each role carries a node kind (agent = an actor that executes; human = a party in the loop). A bearer matching no alias is 'unattributed' — never forced into a role.

kinds.agent: an actor that executes an action
kinds.human: a party kept in the loop (rights-holder, oversight, or authority)

contract: first match in listed order wins; aliases are case-insensitive regex fragments matched against the raw bearer; specific roles precede general ones
grounding: seed set derived from a test-first canonicalization loop over EU GDPR + AI Act bearers (121 raw variants -> 16 roles); extend per domain
